title: Vampire Vape Arctic Fruits 10ml E-Liquid
description: This Arctic Fruit E-Liquid from Vampire Vape is a delicious medley of mixed fruits infused with sweet and delicately spicy aniseed. The tangy sweetness of the fruits plays perfectly with the subtle spice of aniseed while a cool layer of menthol lifts the whole experience on the exhale for a delicious rush of flavour. Vampire Vape Arctic Fruits E-Liquid is the perfect flavour to start your day so don’t forget to add this to your basket before you check out. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please Note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage , sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
